test_title: PYST 34: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I can’t ______ this pain anymore.
solution:
The correct answer is: **bear**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word ""bear"" means to endure or tolerate something difficult or painful.
 
• In the given sentence, the speaker is expressing their inability to tolerate the pain anymore.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **bear**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1) **bier** refers to a stand on which a coffin or corpse is placed before burial or cremation.
 
• Option 2) **boor** refers to an unrefined, ill-mannered person.
 
• Option 4) **beer** refers to an alcoholic drink made from fermented malt.
